tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Ground of every Tatami surface: windows, bar, launcher, notifications, OSD and lock screen. Every text token is checked against it. High contrast deepens it so text reaches AAA.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, popovers and thumbnails in Displays. Day lightens instead of darkening, so text keeps its contrast. In High contrast a raised surface is barely lighter, so it always carries a border-inactive edge.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Selected text in the terminal and selected rows. text-strong, text and text-secondary stay at 4.5:1 or more on it in Night and Day, and 8:1 or more in High contrast.

tokens.name: indigo
tokens.usage: Dyed cloth: the noren in the Genkan icon and other large fields. text-strong reads 4.1:1 on it at night and 6.2:1 in High contrast, so only marks and text 24px or larger go on indigo.

tokens.name: border-inactive
tokens.usage: Unfocused window borders (Hyprland inactive_border). Decorative in Night and Day, under 3:1, so never the only edge of a control there. In High contrast it reaches 3.6:1 on every surface and edges raised surfaces and controls.

tokens.name: text-faint
tokens.usage: Week numbers and weekday labels in the bar's calendar. Kept exact from Tatami but only 2.8:1 (Night) and 2.5:1 (Day) on surface: decorative, repeated labels only, never meaning. High contrast lifts it to 7.3:1 or more.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Notification body text and other secondary copy, on surface, surface-raised and selection: 4.6:1 or more in Night and Day, 8.1:1 or more in High contrast.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Default foreground in the bar, terminal, launcher and windows, on surface, surface-raised and selection (6.4:1 Night, 4.5:1 Day, 10.2:1 High contrast at the lowest).

tokens.name: text-strong
tokens.usage: Headings, the calendar's month, Displays' text and the wordmark's ink. 8.3:1 or more on every surface in Night and Day, 12:1 or more in High contrast.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one accent: the focused window's 2px border, today in the calendar, notification and launcher borders, accent fills, links and focus rings. Text-safe on every surface (5.3:1 Night, 4.5:1 Day, 7.4:1 High contrast at the lowest).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on accent fills, such as today's date: 6.8:1 Night, 6.9:1 Day, 11.2:1 High contrast.

tokens.name: crest
tokens.usage: The crest's ink: always the accent, so the mark holds 4.5:1 or more on surface, surface-raised, selection and white in Night and Day, and 7.4:1 or more in High contrast.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Screen recording, a Keep Awake request without a verified inhibitor, destructive actions and errors. Always with a word or icon. 7.6:1 or more on every High contrast surface.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Applied and verified states. Always with a word or icon: never told from danger by hue alone. 9.9:1 or more on every High contrast surface.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Pending and caution states. Always with a word or icon. 8.8:1 or more on every High contrast surface.

tokens.name: purple
tokens.usage: Terminal magenta and btop graphs. Data only, not interface chrome. 8:1 or more on every High contrast surface.

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: Terminal cyan and btop graphs. Data only, not interface chrome. 8.4:1 or more on every High contrast surface.

families.serif-jp: "Noto Serif JP", "Noto Serif CJK JP", serif

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: Reference only: the wordmark ships as outlines in assets/Logos. Never retype it.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One headline per screen, such as Genkan's welcome title.

styles.name: seal
styles.usage: The kanji beside the wordmark, set vertically in the horizontal lockup.

styles.name: kanji-label
styles.usage: Kanji beside a component's name in a heading: Genkan 玄関. Never Latin text.

styles.name: bar-glyph
styles.usage: JetBrainsMono Nerd Font glyphs in the bar's 27px icon slots.

styles.name: notification
styles.usage: Mako at 10.5pt, text-secondary on surface inside a 2px accent border.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page titles in documentation and on the web.

styles.name: h2
styles.sample: Tatami: a desktop under your fingertips

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Choose your disk, account, desktop, applications, and location.
styles.usage: Running text in documentation, at about 65 characters a line.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Current interface in preview mode, with sample data.

tokens.name: gap-in
tokens.usage: Between tiled windows (Hyprland gaps_in).

tokens.name: bar-edge
tokens.usage: Waybar's left and right margins.

tokens.name: notify-gap
tokens.usage: Between stacked notifications.

tokens.name: gap-out
tokens.usage: Between tiled windows and the screen edge (Hyprland gaps_out).

tokens.name: card-pad-y
tokens.usage: Top and bottom padding inside a notification.

tokens.name: card-pad-x
tokens.usage: Left and right padding inside a notification.

tokens.name: dialog-pad
tokens.usage: Padding inside the launcher's menus.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Every Tatami surface: windows (Hyprland rounding 0), notifications, launcher, OSD and app tiles. The crest is the only round form.

tokens.name: bar-height
tokens.usage: Waybar's height.

tokens.name: workspace-slot
tokens.usage: Width of each workspace button in the bar.

tokens.name: indicator-slot
tokens.usage: Width of the recording, night-light, silence and Keep Awake indicators.

tokens.name: icon-slot
tokens.usage: Width of each tray and status icon slot.

tokens.name: card-width
tokens.usage: Notification width.

tokens.name: border-width
tokens.usage: Window, notification, launcher and focus borders.
